questions.prompt: The United Nations declared 2023 the International Year of Millets, following India's proposal. Should schools serve more millet dishes (ragi, jowar, bajra) in their meals? Give arguments and a conclusion.
questions.modelAnswer: For: millets are rich in fibre, iron, calcium and other minerals (ragi is especially high in calcium); they grow with less water and are hardy in dry, hot climates, so they are good for farmers and the environment; they are part of traditional Indian diets. Against: some children may not like the taste at first; cooks need training; supply and cost may vary. Conclusion: schools should gradually add tasty millet dishes, like ragi dosa or bajra roti, alongside rice and wheat.
